title: 外倾紧凑屈膝
description: 水粉以紧凑屈膝姿态表现浅外倾路线，手脚接触点完整。

art_direction.medium: fine pen and transparent watercolor on warm paper
art_direction.scene: Create an original gouache illustration of a fictional adult keeping a compact bent-knee stance on a shallow overhanging bouldering panel. Both shoes rest on positive footholds just above thick continuous crash mats, and generous violet handholds support a short controlled reach. The knees remain naturally aligned, the torso stays close, and the shoulders show concentration without extreme strain. Use an oblique wide composition with the whole adult and clear landing area, making the shallow wall angle visible. Paint matte mustard, plum, and blue-gray shapes with expressive brushwork. Clothing is opaque. Exclude feet cutting loose, jumps, text, branding, excessive muscularity, and dramatic exposure.
